dedupe_keys.name: peru mobile telephone coverage in cusco by operator 2018 to 2020 hdx from osiptel

description: This HDX dataset holds mobile coverage areas in the Cusco region of Peru for the four mobile operators, Bitel, Claro, Entel and Telefónica (Movistar), for the years 2018, 2019 and 2020. The page states that the information comes from OSIPTEL, Peru's telecommunications regulator, and was prepared by the Institute of Geography of USFQ with the U.S. Department of State for the Hub Latin America. There are eleven zipped shapefiles, one per operator and year, of about 50 to 185 KB each. Coverage: Cusco region, Peru, coverage polygons by operator and year. Format and access: zipped shapefiles on HDX, free under CC BY-SA. Caveats: one region only; the technology (2G, 3G, 4G) split is not stated on the page; derived from regulator data whose own open release was not reached from the cloud session. Simulation uses: operator coverage in an Andean region exposed to earthquakes, landslides and cold waves, for hazard exposure and redundancy analysis between operators. Related records: data-global-mobile-coverage-raster-1km-1999-2030 gives modelled coverage for comparison; data-opencellid gives crowdsourced cell positions in Peru.
